theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P))) (E : Set (Euclid P)) (Q : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.2) → IsClosed E → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m + 1].restrict E), ∃ p ∈ s, ∃ y : Euclid (m + 1), (∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1) ∧ WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ) = x) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Q → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) E → Q ω = 0) → ∃ u : (Fin P → ℤ) × (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, (∀ p ∈ s, ∀ y, ∃ z : ℤ, u p y = z) ∧ (∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (u p) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u p y|) ≤ Q.mass ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Q ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.1 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => EuclideanSpace.single (p.2 k) (1 : ℝ))
